# FAQ-023 Engineering FAQ #23

Q: What is the lubricant part number for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02)?
A: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is CFW-LUB-426. Use CFW-LUB-426 in all requisitions and verify receipt against SB-1016.

Q: What is the blast wheel liner bolt torque specification for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03)?
A: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m. Tighten to 90 N·m and confirm per SOP-P2-L4-03 before returning equipment to service.

Q: What is the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03)?
A: The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar. Do not operate above 320 bar; reference SB-1016 for safety margins and SOP-P2-L4-03 for isolation procedures.

Q: What is the lubricant part number for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02)?
A: The lubricant part number for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is CFW-LUB-278. Stock CFW-LUB-278 in the designated bin and use SOP-P3-L1-05 for lubrication sequence.

Q: What is the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03)?
A: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Apply 1600 N·m using a calibrated torque device and record the action per SOP-P3-L1-05.

Related documents: SB-1016, SOP-P2-L4-03, SOP-P3-L1-05
